Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.loot

Class ItemDrop

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.Entity
com.epitech.depthdiablo.loot.ItemDrop
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rewindable, Collidable, Updatable
public final class ItemDrop extends Entity
An item lying on the ground (GDD 1.4): dropped by a monster or by the player, or placed in a room. Characters walk over it; the player takes it with the pickup key when in range.
